036/**
037 * Represents a top-level schema object bean in the JSON-Schema core specification.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * This implementation follows the JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 specification.
041 *
042 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
043 * <p class='bjava'>
044 *    <jc>// Create a simple schema for a person object</jc>
045 *    JsonSchema <jv>schema</jv> = <jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
046 *       .setIdUri(<js>"https://example.com/person.schema.json"</js>)
047 *       .setSchemaVersionUri(<js>"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"</js>)
048 *       .setTitle(<js>"Person"</js>)
049 *       .setDescription(<js>"A person object"</js>)
050 *       .setType(JsonType.<jsf>OBJECT</jsf>)
051 *       .addProperties(
052 *          <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"firstName"</js>, JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>)
053 *             .setMinLength(1)
054 *             .setMaxLength(50),
055 *          <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"lastName"</js>, JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>)
056 *             .setMinLength(1)
057 *             .setMaxLength(50),
058 *          <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"age"</js>, JsonType.<jsf>INTEGER</jsf>)
059 *             .setMinimum(0)
060 *             .setExclusiveMaximum(150)
061 *       )
062 *       .addRequired(<js>"firstName"</js>, <js>"lastName"</js>);
063 *
064 *    <jc>// Serialize to JSON Schema</jc>
065 *    String <jv>json</jv> = JsonSerializer.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>.write(<jv>schema</jv>);
066 * </p>
067 *
068 * <p>
069 * Output:
070 * <p class='bjson'>
071 *    {
072 *       <js>"$id"</js>: <js>"https://example.com/person.schema.json"</js>,
073 *       <js>"$schema"</js>: <js>"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"</js>,
074 *       <js>"title"</js>: <js>"Person"</js>,
075 *       <js>"description"</js>: <js>"A person object"</js>,
076 *       <js>"type"</js>: <js>"object"</js>,
077 *       <js>"properties"</js>: {
078 *          <js>"firstName"</js>: {
079 *             <js>"type"</js>: <js>"string"</js>,
080 *             <js>"minLength"</js>: 1,
081 *             <js>"maxLength"</js>: 50
082 *          },
083 *          <js>"lastName"</js>: {
084 *             <js>"type"</js>: <js>"string"</js>,
085 *             <js>"minLength"</js>: 1,
086 *             <js>"maxLength"</js>: 50
087 *          },
088 *          <js>"age"</js>: {
089 *             <js>"type"</js>: <js>"integer"</js>,
090 *             <js>"minimum"</js>: 0,
091 *             <js>"exclusiveMaximum"</js>: 150
092 *          }
093 *       },
094 *       <js>"required"</js>: [<js>"firstName"</js>, <js>"lastName"</js>]
095 *    }
096 * </p>
097 *
098 * <h5 class='section'>Key Features:</h5>
099 * <ul class='spaced-list'>
100 *    <li><b>Draft 2020-12 Support:</b> Includes all properties from the latest JSON Schema specification
101 *    <li><b>Backward Compatibility:</b> Deprecated Draft 04 properties (like <c>id</c> and <c>definitions</c>) are still supported
102 *    <li><b>Fluent API:</b> All setter methods return <c>this</c> for method chaining
103 *    <li><b>Type Safety:</b> Uses enums and typed collections for validation
104 *    <li><b>Serialization:</b> Can be serialized to any format supported by Juneau (JSON, XML, HTML, etc.)
105 *    <li><b>Auto Generation:</b> Use {@link JsonSchemaBeanGenerator} to generate schemas from Java types
106 * </ul>
107 *
108 * <h5 class='section'>Common Use Cases:</h5>
109 *
110 * <p><b>1. Simple Type Constraints:</b>
111 * <p class='bjava'>
112 *    <jc>// String with length constraints</jc>
113 *    JsonSchema <jv>schema</jv> = <jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
114 *       .setType(JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>)
115 *       .setMinLength(5)
116 *       .setMaxLength(100)
117 *       .setPattern(<js>"^[A-Za-z]+$"</js>);
118 * </p>
119 *
120 * <p><b>2. Numeric Ranges:</b>
121 * <p class='bjava'>
122 *    <jc>// Number between 0 and 100 (exclusive)</jc>
123 *    JsonSchema <jv>schema</jv> = <jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
124 *       .setType(JsonType.<jsf>NUMBER</jsf>)
125 *       .setExclusiveMinimum(0)
126 *       .setExclusiveMaximum(100)
127 *       .setMultipleOf(0.5);
128 * </p>
129 *
130 * <p><b>3. Enumerations:</b>
131 * <p class='bjava'>
132 *    <jc>// Status field with allowed values</jc>
133 *    JsonSchema <jv>schema</jv> = <jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
134 *       .setType(JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>)
135 *       .addEnum(<js>"pending"</js>, <js>"active"</js>, <js>"completed"</js>);
136 * </p>
137 *
138 * <p><b>4. Arrays:</b>
139 * <p class='bjava'>
140 *    <jc>// Array of strings with constraints</jc>
141 *    JsonSchema <jv>schema</jv> = <jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
142 *       .setType(JsonType.<jsf>ARRAY</jsf>)
143 *       .setItems(<jk>new</jk> JsonSchema().setType(JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>))
144 *       .setMinItems(1)
145 *       .setMaxItems(10)
146 *       .setUniqueItems(<jk>true</jk>);
147 * </p>
148 *
149 * <p><b>5. Conditional Schemas (Draft 07+):</b>
150 * <p class='bjava'>
151 *    <jc>// Different validation based on country</jc>
152 *    JsonSchema <jv>schema</jv> = <jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
153 *       .setType(JsonType.<jsf>OBJECT</jsf>)
154 *       .addProperties(
155 *          <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"country"</js>, JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>),
156 *          <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"postalCode"</js>, JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>)
157 *       )
158 *       .setIf(<jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
159 *          .addProperties(<jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"country"</js>).setConst(<js>"USA"</js>))
160 *       )
161 *       .setThen(<jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
162 *          .addProperties(<jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"postalCode"</js>).setPattern(<js>"^[0-9]{5}$"</js>))
163 *       );
164 * </p>
165 *
166 * <p><b>6. Reusable Definitions:</b>
167 * <p class='bjava'>
168 *    <jc>// Schema with reusable components using $defs</jc>
169 *    JsonSchema <jv>schema</jv> = <jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
170 *       .setType(JsonType.<jsf>OBJECT</jsf>)
171 *       .addDef(<js>"address"</js>, <jk>new</jk> JsonSchema()
172 *          .setType(JsonType.<jsf>OBJECT</jsf>)
173 *          .addProperties(
174 *             <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"street"</js>, JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>),
175 *             <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"city"</js>, JsonType.<jsf>STRING</jsf>)
176 *          )
177 *       )
178 *       .addProperties(
179 *          <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"billingAddress"</js>)
180 *             .setRef(<js>"#/$defs/address"</js>),
181 *          <jk>new</jk> JsonSchemaProperty(<js>"shippingAddress"</js>)
182 *             .setRef(<js>"#/$defs/address"</js>)
183 *       );
184 * </p>
185 *
186 * <h5 class='section'>Migration from Draft 04:</h5>
187 * <ul class='spaced-list'>
188 *    <li>Use {@link #setIdUri(Object)} instead of {@link #setId(Object)} (deprecated)
189 *    <li>Use {@link #setDefs(Map)} instead of {@link #setDefinitions(Map)} (deprecated but still works)
190 *    <li>Use {@link #setExclusiveMaximum(Number)} with a numeric value instead of a boolean flag
191 *    <li>Use {@link #setExclusiveMinimum(Number)} with a numeric value instead of a boolean flag
192 * </ul>
193 *
194 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
195 *    <li class='link'><a href="https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/json-schema-core.html">JSON Schema 2020-12 Core</a>
196 *    <li class='link'><a href="https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/json-schema-validation.html">JSON Schema 2020-12 Validation</a>
197 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauBeanJsonSchema">juneau-bean-jsonschema</a>
198 * </ul>
199 *
200 * @param <SELF> The self type for fluent setters.
201 */
202@Marshalled(typeName = "schema")
203@SuppressWarnings({
204   "java:S116", // Field names follow OpenAPI/JSON Schema spec
205   "java:S119", // 'SELF' (CRTP self-type) is intentional and clearer than a single-letter name.
206   "java:S6539" // Monster class; JsonSchema intentionally models the entire JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 keyword set as one cohesive bean
207})
208public class JsonSchema<SELF extends JsonSchema<SELF>> {
209
210   /**
211    * Used during parsing to convert the <property>additionalItems</property> property to the correct class type.
212    *
213    * <ul class='spaced-list'>
214    *    <li>
215    *       If parsing a JSON-array, converts to a {@link JsonSchemaArray}.
216    *    <li>
217    *       If parsing a JSON-boolean, converts to a {@link Boolean}.
218    * </ul>
219    *
220    * <p>
221    * Serialization method is a no-op.
222    */
223   public static class BooleanOrSchemaArraySwap extends ObjectSwap<Object,Object> {
224
225      @Override /* Overridden from ObjectSwap */
226      public Object swap(MarshallingSession session, Object o) throws SerializeException {
227         return o;
228      }
229
230      @Override /* Overridden from ObjectSwap */
231      public Object unswap(MarshallingSession session, Object o, ClassMeta<?> hint) throws ParseException {
232         var cm = (o instanceof Collection ? session.getClassMeta(JsonSchemaArray.class) : session.getClassMeta(Boolean.class));
233         return session.convertToType(o, cm);
234      }
235   }
236
237   /**
238    * Used during parsing to convert the <property>additionalProperties</property> property to the correct class type.
239    *
240    * <ul class='spaced-list'>
241    *    <li>
242    *       If parsing a JSON-object, converts to a {@link JsonSchema}.
243    *    <li>
244    *       If parsing a JSON-boolean, converts to a {@link Boolean}.
245    * </ul>
246    *
247    * <p>
248    * Serialization method is a no-op.
249    */
250   public static class BooleanOrSchemaSwap extends ObjectSwap<Object,Object> {
251
252      @Override /* Overridden from ObjectSwap */
253      public Object swap(MarshallingSession session, Object o) throws SerializeException {
254         return o;
255      }
256
257      @Override /* Overridden from ObjectSwap */
258      public Object unswap(MarshallingSession session, Object o, ClassMeta<?> hint) throws ParseException {
259         var cm = (o instanceof Boolean ? session.getClassMeta(Boolean.class) : session.getClassMeta(JsonSchema.class));
260         return session.convertToType(o, cm);
261      }
262   }

264   /**
265    * Used during parsing to convert the <property>items</property> property to the correct class type.
266    *
267    * <ul class='spaced-list'>

269    *       If parsing a JSON-array, converts to a {@link JsonSchemaArray}.
270    *    <li>

272    * </ul>
273    *
274    * <p>

277   public static class JsonSchemaOrSchemaArraySwap extends ObjectSwap<Object,Object> {

279      @Override /* Overridden from ObjectSwap */

281         return o;
282      }
283
284      @Override /* Overridden from ObjectSwap */

286         var cm = (o instanceof Collection ? session.getClassMeta(JsonSchemaArray.class) : session.getClassMeta(JsonSchema.class));
287         return session.convertToType(o, cm);

291   /**
292    * Used during parsing to convert the <property>type</property> property to the correct class type.
293    *
294    * <ul class='spaced-list'>
295    *    <li>
296    *       If parsing a JSON-array, converts to a {@link JsonTypeArray}.
297    *    <li>
298    *       If parsing a JSON-object, converts to a {@link JsonType}.
299    * </ul>
300    *
301    * <p>
302    * Serialization method is a no-op.

304   public static class JsonTypeOrJsonTypeArraySwap extends ObjectSwap<Object,Object> {

306      @Override /* Overridden from ObjectSwap */

315      }

394   /**
395    * Generates a {@link JsonSchema} bean from the specified type using {@link JsonSchemaBeanGenerator#DEFAULT}.
396    *
397    * @param type The type to generate a schema for.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>, or an {@link IllegalArgumentException} is thrown.
398    * @return The generated schema bean, or <jk>null</jk> if a schema could not be generated for the type.
399    */
400   @SuppressWarnings({
401      "java:S1452" // Self-bounded (CRTP) generic: the generated schema's concrete SELF subtype is not known here, so JsonSchema<?> is the only sound return type.
402   })
403   public static JsonSchema<?> of(Type type) {
404      return JsonSchemaBeanGenerator.DEFAULT.generate(type);
405   }
406
407   /**
408    * Generates a {@link JsonSchema} bean from the specified class using {@link JsonSchemaBeanGenerator#DEFAULT}.
409    *
410    * @param type The class to generate a schema for.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>, or an {@link IllegalArgumentException} is thrown.
411    * @return The generated schema bean, or <jk>null</jk> if a schema could not be generated for the class.
412    */
413   @SuppressWarnings({
414      "java:S1452" // Self-bounded (CRTP) generic: the generated schema's concrete SELF subtype is not known here, so JsonSchema<?> is the only sound return type.

416   public static JsonSchema<?> of(Class<?> type) {

418   }

420   /**
421    * Bean property appender:  <property>additionalItems</property>.
422    *
423    * @param value
424    *    The list of items to append to the <property>additionalItems</property> property on this bean.
425    * @return This object.
426    */
427   public SELF addAdditionalItems(JsonSchema<?>...value) {
428      if (this.additionalItemsSchemaArray == null)
429         this.additionalItemsSchemaArray = new JsonSchemaArray();
430      this.additionalItemsSchemaArray.addAll(value);
431      setMasterOn(value);
432      return self();
433   }
434
435   /**
436    * Bean property appender:  <property>allOf</property>.
437    *
438    * @param value The list of items to append to the <property>allOf</property> property on this bean.
439    * @return This object.
440    */
441   public SELF addAllOf(JsonSchema<?>...value) {
442      setMasterOn(value);
443      this.allOf = addAll(this.allOf, value);
444      return self();
445   }
446
447   /**
448    * Bean property appender:  <property>allOf</property>.
449    *
450    * @param value The collection of items to append to the <property>allOf</property> property on this bean.
451    * @return This object.
452    */
453   public SELF addAllOf(Collection<JsonSchema<?>> value) {
454      setMasterOn(value);
455      this.allOf = addAll(this.allOf, value == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(value));
456      return self();
457   }

459   /**
460    * Bean property appender:  <property>anyOf</property>.
461    *
462    * @param value The list of items to append to the <property>anyOf</property> property on this bean.
463    * @return This object.
464    */
465   public SELF addAnyOf(JsonSchema<?>...value) {
466      if (this.anyOf == null)
467         this.anyOf = new LinkedList<>();
468      setMasterOn(value);
469      for (var s : value)
470         this.anyOf.add(s);
471      return self();
472   }

1314   /**

1319    * {@link #resolve()}.
1320    * Therefore, <property>getProperty(name, <jk>true</jk>)</property> is equivalent to calling
1321    * <property>getProperty(name).resolve()</property>, except it's safe from a potential
1322    * <property>NullPointerException</property>.

1324    * @param name The property name.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (no property has a <jk>null</jk> name, so <jk>null</jk> is returned).
1325    * @param resolve If <jk>true</jk>, calls {@link #resolve()} on object before returning.
1326    * @return The property with the specified name, or <jk>null</jk> if no property is specified.
1327    */
1328   @SuppressWarnings({
1329      "java:S1452" // Self-bounded (CRTP) generic: 'properties' map values are declared JsonSchema<?> since callers may attach any concrete SELF subtype.
1330   })
1331   public JsonSchema<?> getProperty(String name, boolean resolve) {
1332      if (properties == null)
1333         return null;
1334      var s = properties.get(name);
1335      if (s == null)
1336         return null;
1337      if (resolve)
1338         s = s.resolve();
1339      return s;
1340   }

1502    * simply returns this object.

1512      return master.schemaMap.get(ref);
